invariants.fieldVectorConvention: u east-positive, v north-positive, meteorological direction is FROM clockwise from north
invariants.baseMapProjection: Plate Carree only if nominal 2:1 aspect is preserved; show viewport stretch separately
invariants.unitTime: simulated_seconds = min(real_elapsed_ms,100ms)/1000 * dimensionless_rate; bounded per foreground frame after tab suspension
invariants.outsideField: do not silently extrapolate outside source spatial coverage
invariants.geographicSeam: never connect an antimeridian discontinuity or particle respawn with a drawn trajectory
invariants.selectedState: only one authoritative controller for mode, play, time, and URL selection state
invariants.urlIsolation: preserve non-Flow search parameters while replacing only validated flow-prefixed keys
invariants.reducedMotion: respect system preference and offer persistent pause
invariants.cleanup: listeners, intervals, animation frames and observers are removed on unmount
invariants.fieldLineage: field sampled as instantaneous model snapshot; fixed-step RK2 path is a frozen-field experiment, not an actual tracked object
invariants.noExtrapolation: regular or GFS samples outside latitude coverage return {valid:false} rather than clamping
invariants.onePlaybackController: base flow-lab.js owns mode, pause, tripPlay, tripTime and all simulation progression; Round2 never installs a second interval

uiTargets.mapReadability: all mode-critical controls are outside map content in WORK and INSPECT
uiTargets.focusMode: map-focused layout remains interactive; controls are accessible without blocking geography
uiTargets.mobile: no overlapping controls and map; touch inspection has a persistent result
